outcome: dose of prostaglandins needed for induction
cohort: Women suited for labor induction at Ain-Shams Maternity Hospital, Cairo, Egypt.
finding: Membrane sweeping at the initiation of labor induction reduced the induction to delivery interval and the rate of cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Membrane sweeping at the initiation of labor induction reduced the rates of cesarean delivery and operative vaginal delivery, while increasing the rate of spontaneous vaginal delivery.
